surface: Alpha, in progress: 35 of 43 upstream subpaths. The implemented surface has a complete byte-exact upstream inventory, 98 same-fixture React/Octane differential cases, and 49 Accordion, Collapsible, and Tabs adapted cases. This is bounded evidence and remains recorded-unverified because eight public subpaths and most of the canonical runtime/type suite are not yet adapted. Menu covers all 20 upstream parts, Toast all 11 parts, Collapsible all 3 parts, Accordion all 5 parts, and Tabs 4 of 5 parts (Indicator unported).
divergences: `native-event-semantics`: Host handlers receive native DOM events rather than React synthetic events; text edits use native `input`, form-facing NumberField commits use native `change`, and propagation reads `cancelBubble`.
`ref-as-prop-class-composition`: React `forwardRef` wrappers become ref-as-prop, and class values use Octane's composition rules.
`unported-internal-hover`: The internal standalone floating-ui-react `useHover` combiner is not republished because no ported Base UI component consumes it.
`number-field-interaction-gaps`: `NumberField.ScrubArea` and hold-to-repeat stepping remain unported; steppers respond to single presses only.
ssr: Dedicated Node-mode tests cover server snapshots, accessible separators, edge-aligned slider visibility, and closed dialogs; hydration adopts Vite-compiled Octane server markup, transitions to the client snapshot, and preserves interaction. Open overlays and remaining components are not yet covered.
